test_keep_alive_argument: test the pybind11 keep_alive call policy on function arguments to verify child objects are retained
test_keep_alive_return_value: test the pybind11 keep_alive call policy on return values to verify child objects survive after the call
test_alive_gc: test garbage collection behavior with circular references when keep_alive is used on pybind11 objects
test_keep_alive_constructor: test the pybind11 keep_alive call policy on constructors to verify argument lifetime is extended
test_call_guard: test the pybind11 call_guard policy to verify thread guards and GIL behavior on wrapped C++ functions
